_doc: Home screen with the fuel gauge never answering (--i2c-faults 1.0:fuel-gauge): the battery level is unknown, and an unknown level is not an empty battery.

power.battery_low_told.why: no low-battery warning from an unknown level

power.low_battery_off.why: an unknown level must never power the device off

panic.count.why: the system must survive a dead gauge
